description: In any fixed first-order language, no ordinary first-order sentence is true exactly in the structures with infinite nonempty domain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.InfinitaryLogic.infinity_not_firstOrder.{u, v} (L : FirstOrder.Language) :
  ¬∃ θ, ∀ (M : Type (max u v)) (x : L.Structure M), Nonempty M → (M ⊨ θ ↔ Infinite M)
